title: Skyblock gets clearer progression and reliable Bedrock trading
summary: The generator is now a visible island landmark, Workers unlock through play, and Bedrock merchant menus recover instead of waiting forever.
body:
- Bedrock merchant forms now recover from rejected, outdated or slow server responses, with bounded loading, retry paths and safer transaction timeouts.
- The manual generator is now marked by a cross-platform structure with its tier, drop chances and merchant values, plus distinct colors and feedback for every tier.
- Generator menus explain the complete break, pick up, deposit and sell loop on Java and Bedrock.
- New islands keep the tier-one cobblestone generator but unlock the Miner, Farmer and Lumberjack progressively instead of receiving three automatic Workers immediately. Existing Workers and their stored capacity are preserved.
- Generator upgrades now require both island coins and stored resources. Merchant prices remain unchanged.
- Island build radius now grows with island level instead of generator tier.
- Worker menus and the mobile companion show production speed, capacity, time before saturation and unlock requirements.
- Aggregate balancing measurements now cover generator breaks, warehouse deposits, Worker collection, merchant sales, upgrade timing and storage pressure without identifying individual players.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
